_note: Structure Arc slice 1 (STRUCTURE-ARC-LOCKS-2026-08-05.md LOCK 2) — the first hand-authored dungeon interior, the pattern exemplar for every authored dungeon after it, wired to Operation 1 via data/operations.json's authoredLayout field. The floor plan (`rows`) is fixed data, never generated at runtime: '#' wall, '.' floor. entrance/start are authored coordinates (not searched for, unlike the procedural kit). CONTENTS randomize within the authored budgets below: each `spawns[]` room draws a being from its `pool` seeded off the dungeon seed (a fixed ROOM, a random OCCUPANT); `milestones[]` sit at fixed points and are granted once, guaranteeing forward progress regardless of loot luck. Verified connected (flood-fill from `start` reaches every floor tile, including both spawns and the milestone) by the script that produced this file; see test/authoreddungeon.test.js for the standing regression. Shape: entrance room (south) -> corridor -> junction room (2 inhabitant spawns) -> corridor -> inner sanctum (the milestone).

milestones.description: Primary Calibration Standard: a machined brass cylinder etched with concentric decay scales, recovered to verify local reality drift against established parameters.
